## 2) Customizable rendering / player properties

### A. Global rendering colors & fonts (`settings.display.resources`)

Primary score styling path (documented as preferred over arbitrary CSS). From [live `RenderingResources` docs](https://www.alphatab.net/docs/reference/settings/display/resources):

**Colors (6):**
- `staffLineColor`
- `barSeparatorColor`
- `barNumberColor`
- `mainGlyphColor`
- `secondaryGlyphColor`
- `scoreInfoColor`

**Fonts (many):** `titleFont`, `subTitleFont`, `copyrightFont`, `wordsFont`, `effectFont`, `timerFont`, `directionsFont`, `fretboardNumberFont`, `tablatureFont`, `graceFont`, `barNumberFont`, `fingeringFont`, `inlineFingeringFont`, `markerFont`, `numberedNotationFont`, `numberedNotationGraceFont`, plus maps `defaultFonts`, `elementFonts`, and `engravingSettings`.

**Site defaults** (Noto families) are set in `environment.ts` for most of the above font slots.

**Playground color pickers** expose exactly those 6 color properties under “Display ▸ Colors”.

### B. Per-element programmatic coloring (data model `style`)

Via `score.style`, `track.style`, `bar.style`, `voice.style`, `beat.style`, `note.style` and sub-element enums:

- `ScoreSubElement`, `TrackSubElement`, `BarSubElement`, `VoiceSubElement`, `BeatSubElement`, `NoteSubElement`

Documented in `/docs/guides/coloring.mdx` with generated type reference under `docs/reference/types/model/*subelement/` (build-time generated).

`FormattingTemplateSample` also uses:
- `score.style.headerAndFooter` (templates, visibility, alignment)
- `score.style.colors.set(ScoreSubElement.*, color)`

### C. Display / layout settings (76 reference pages under `docs/reference/settings/`)

**Playground exposes:**
- `core.engine` (svg / html5)
- `display.scale`, `display.stretchForce`, `display.layoutMode`, `display.barsPerRow`, `display.startBar`, `display.barCount`, `display.justifyLastSystem`, `display.systemsLayoutMode`
- All padding fields listed in playground “Display ▸ Paddings”
- Full font list in “Display ▸ Fonts”

**Also in reference but not all in playground UI:** `display.staveProfile`, `display.barCountPerPartial`, etc. Showcase/docs pass these via `<AlphaTab settings={...} />`.

### D. Notation settings

**Playground:** `notation.fingeringMode`, `notation.rhythmMode`, `notation.rhythmHeight`, `notation.smallGraceTabNotes`, `notation.extendBendArrowsOnTiedNotes`, `notation.extendLineEffectsToBeatEnd`, `notation.slurHeight`

**Reference only (not in playground):** `notation.elements`, `notation.notationMode`, transposition settings, etc.

### E. Player settings (`settings.player.*`)

**Playground toggles/inputs:**
- `player.playerMode`, `player.enableCursor`, `player.enableAnimatedBeatCursor`, `player.enableElementHighlighting`, `player.enableUserInteraction`
- `player.scrollOffsetX/Y`, `player.scrollMode`
- `player.songBookBendDuration`, `player.songBookDipDuration`
- `player.vibrato.*` (note/beat wide/slight length & amplitude)
- `player.slide.*` (simple/shift duration ratios)
- `player.playTripletFeel`

**Reference player settings (not all in playground UI):** `enablePlayer`, `soundFont`, `scrollElement`, `scrollSpeed`, `bufferTimeInMilliseconds`, `outputMode`, `nativeBrowserSmoothScroll`, etc.

**Runtime API (playground + homepage):**
- `masterVolume`, `metronomeVolume`, `countInVolume`, `playbackSpeed`, `looping`
- Track mute/solo/volume/transposition via UI components

**Component defaults differ by surface:**
- `AlphaTab`: `playerMode = EnabledAutomatic`, `scrollMode = Off` when `player` prop set
- `AlphaTabFull`: `EnabledAutomatic`, `ScrollMode.Continuous`
- `AlphaTabPlayground`: `EnabledSynthesizer`, `core.engine = 'svg'`

### F. Stylesheet (`score.stylesheet`)

**Playground exposes:** `hideDynamics`, `bracketExtendMode`, `useSystemSignSeparator`, `globalDisplayTuning`, `globalDisplayChordDiagramsOnTop`, track-name policies/orientations, multi-bar rest toggles.

**alphaTex** also configures many of these: `/docs/alphatex/stylesheet.mdx`.

### G. Player overlay CSS (alphaTab-generated DOM, styled by site CSS)

Global classes documented in `/docs/guides/styling-player.mdx` and duplicated in `custom.scss` + `AlphaTabFull/styles.module.scss`:

| Class | What it styles |
|-------|----------------|
| `.at-selection div` | User selection range background |
| `.at-cursor-bar` | Current bar highlight during playback |
| `.at-cursor-beat` | Beat cursor (width + color) |
| `.at-highlight *` | SVG note highlight during playback (`fill` / `stroke`) |

**Site chrome CSS** (custom player UI, not alphaTab core): `.at-wrap`, `.at-footer`, `.at-player`, `.at-sidebar`, `.at-track*`, `.at-time-slider*`, `.at-controls` (tutorial), etc.

---

## 3) Not (fully) customizable on this site

| Area | Limitation |
|------|------------|
| **Dark mode for scores** | Docusaurus has `[data-theme="dark"]` for site chrome, but **`colorMode.disableSwitch: true`** (no user toggle). AlphaTab score colors stay light-oriented (black glyphs, gray staff lines). Player shells use hardcoded `#fff` / `#436d9d` with **no** `[data-theme="dark"]` overrides. |
| **Theme sync** | No listener updates `display.resources` or element styles when Docusaurus theme changes. |
| **General SVG/CSS styling** | Docs explicitly warn CSS styling of notation **cannot be guaranteed**; use `display.resources` + model `style` instead. |
| **`.at-highlight`** | **SVG engine only**; HTML5 canvas engine cannot use this CSS approach. |
| **Playground gaps** | Comment `// TODO: advanced coloring` — per-element coloring not in settings panel. `notation.elements` marked TODO. Stylesheet section has a likely miswired control (Multi-Track Name Policy reuses `otherSystemsTrackNameOrientation` accessor). |
| **Built-in song details** | Horizontal layout hides them; site recommends external DOM (`/docs/guides/song-details.mdx`). |
| **Custom homepage/playground chrome** | Footer, sidebar, sliders are **website React/CSS**, not alphaTab settings — styled for light UI only. |
| **Generated type docs** | `docs/reference/types/` is gitignored; run `npm run generate-alphatabdoc` before build for full SubElement/color API pages locally. |

---

## 4) Commands & routes for screenshots

### Commands (`package.json`)

```bash
npm start # dev server → http://localhost:3000
npm run serve # serve production build after build
npm run build # production build
npm run generate-alphatabdoc # regenerate reference types from @coderline/alphatab
```

Optional URL param: `?loglevel=debug` (handled in `environment.ts`).

### Best screenshot routes

| Route | What to capture |
|-------|-----------------|
| `/` | `AlphaTabFull` — full player + cursors/highlights while playing |
| `/docs/playground` | Live settings panel (colors, fonts, layout, player) — fullscreen via `body.playground` |
| `/docs/guides/coloring` | Per-note coloring demo + sample code |
| `/docs/guides/styling-player` | Documented cursor/selection CSS (reference images in `/static/img/guides/styling/`) |
| `/docs/guides/formatting-templates` | Header/footer template + color demo |
| `/docs/tutorial-web/player` | Tutorial cursor CSS snippets |
| `/docs/tutorial-web/controls` | Toolbar styling (`.at-controls`) |
| `/docs/showcase/layouts` | Layout/zoom variations |
| `/docs/showcase/general`, `guitar-tabs`, `music-notation`, `effects`, etc. | Embedded `<AlphaTab />` rendering examples |
| `/docs/reference/settings/display/resources` | Full `RenderingResources` property list |

### CSS variables / classes summary

**Docusaurus site theme:** `--ifm-color-primary*` (light + `[data-theme="dark"]`), `--prism-background-color`, `--docusaurus-highlighted-code-line-bg`.

**alphaTab playback overlays (global):** `.at-cursor-bar`, `.at-selection`, `.at-cursor-beat`, `.at-highlight`.

**Website player chrome:** scoped modules under `AlphaTabFull/` and `AlphaTabPlayground/` plus tutorial classes `.at-controls`, `.at-song-title`, etc.

---

**Architecture in one line:** score appearance is driven mainly by **`display.resources` + model `style` coloring**; playback feedback uses **four global CSS classes**; the **homepage/playground UI** is custom light-themed React/CSS layered on top — independent of Docusaurus dark mode.

- Add a dedicated **Style / Theme** area with Light/Dark preset buttons, live render refresh, and grouped controls.
- Expand **Display** coverage to include missing settings like `staveProfile`, `barCountPerPartial`, and `effectBandPaddingBottom`.
- Convert all AlphaTab color fields to proper color pickers and add model-level style coloring for score/track/bar/voice/beat/note sub-elements.

- Add an **Advanced Engraving** section for lower-level metrics, but grouped/collapsed so it does not overwhelm normal style editing.
- Fix existing miswired controls I noticed in `playground-settings.tsx`, including duplicate/wrong stylesheet accessors and slide duration wiring.

Because the current `develop` checkout has untracked doc work and a modified `.gitignore`, I’ll create an isolated branch/worktree from `develop` for this feature after approval so I don’t mix those changes into the playground work.
